treatments.name: Hydra Facial
treatments.seoTitle: Hydra Facial in Dubai | Bloom Clinic Dubai
treatments.seoDesc: Hydra Facial in Dubai at Bloom Clinic Dubai. See what to expect, who it may suit and how to request a consultation.
treatments.heading: Hydra Facial at Bloom Clinic Dubai
paragraphs: A Hydra Facial is a multi-step facial that cleanses, exfoliates and hydrates the skin. At **Bloom Clinic Dubai**, your therapist starts with a conversation about your skin and what you would like to discuss, then explains how the treatment would work for you.

Looking for facials in Dubai? Bloom Clinic is an aesthetic and laser clinic offering a range of [face treatments](#services-face), from relaxing facials and the [Oxygeneo Facial](#treatment-oxygeneo-facial) to skin peels and microdermabrasion. A consultation helps you compare options and decide at your own pace.

steps.title: Cleanse
steps.text: Your therapist cleanses the skin and removes make-up and surface debris.

steps.title: Exfoliate and extract
steps.text: A gentle exfoliation and suction step lifts away dead skin cells and loosens congestion from pores.

steps.title: Hydrate
steps.text: Serums chosen for your skin are applied to nourish and hydrate.

steps.title: Protect
steps.text: The session finishes with moisturiser and sun protection, which matters in Dubai's strong sun.

treatments.stepsNote: Your therapist confirms the exact steps, products and session length at your consultation.
suit: People who would like to discuss hydration and skin texture
Anyone comparing facials in Dubai before choosing a treatment
People who want a facial with a clear explanation of each step
prep: Tell the team about your skincare products, medicines and allergies
Mention any recent sun exposure or skin treatments
Use sun protection afterwards and follow your therapist's advice

faqs.q: Is a Hydra Facial suitable for every skin type?
faqs.a: It is used on a range of skin types. Your therapist checks your skin at a consultation and tells you if another facial would suit you better.

faqs.q: How many sessions will I need?
faqs.a: That depends on your skin and what you would like to improve. Your therapist can suggest a plan and explain what to expect from it.

faqs.q: Is there downtime after a Hydra Facial?
faqs.a: Many people return to normal activities afterwards. Some notice mild redness or sensitivity. Your therapist explains what to expect for your skin.

faqs.q: Can I combine it with other treatments?
faqs.a: Often, but the timing matters. Tell the team about any laser, peel or other skin treatments you have had or plan to have, and they will advise on spacing.

faqs.q: How do I request a Hydra Facial at Bloom Clinic Dubai?
faqs.a: Use the request form on this page or the Contact page. Our team will contact you about availability.

treatments.name: Skin Tags Removal
treatments.seoTitle: Skin Tag Removal in Dubai | Bloom Clinic Dubai
treatments.seoDesc: Skin tag removal in Dubai at Bloom Clinic Dubai. See what to expect, who it may suit and how to request a consultation.
treatments.heading: Skin Tag Removal at Bloom Clinic Dubai
paragraphs: Skin tags are small, soft growths of skin that often appear on the neck, eyelids, underarms or other areas where skin folds. Many people ask about removing them because they catch on clothing or jewellery, or because of how they look. At **Bloom Clinic Dubai**, your specialist examines the area first and explains the options that may suit you.
Looking for skin tag removal in Dubai? Bloom Clinic offers a range of [face treatments](#services-face) and skin care. A consultation lets you ask questions and decide at your own pace.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: Your specialist asks about the growth, how long it has been there and any changes, then examines it.

steps.title: Plan
steps.text: Your specialist explains whether removal is suitable and which method they would use.

steps.title: Treatment
steps.text: The area is cleaned and the skin tag is removed by your specialist using the agreed method.

steps.title: Aftercare
steps.text: You receive clear advice on caring for the area and protecting it from the sun while it heals.

treatments.stepsNote: Your specialist confirms the method, any numbing and the session length at your consultation.
suit: People with small, soft growths that irritate or bother them
People who want a specialist to check the growth before any treatment
Anyone who would like the options and aftercare explained first
prep: Tell the team about your medicines, allergies and any bleeding or healing problems
Do not try to cut or remove a skin tag yourself
Keep the area clean and protected from the sun, and follow your specialist's advice

faqs.q: Are skin tags harmful?
faqs.a: Skin tags are usually harmless, but any growth that changes, bleeds or looks unusual should be examined by a specialist before treatment.

faqs.q: Can skin tags come back after removal?
faqs.a: A removed skin tag does not usually grow back in the same place, but new ones can form elsewhere. Your specialist can tell you what to expect.

faqs.q: Is removal painful?
faqs.a: Comfort depends on the size and site of the skin tag and the method used. Your specialist explains what you may feel and how comfort is managed.

faqs.q: How long does healing take?
faqs.a: This depends on the area and method. Your specialist gives you aftercare advice and tells you what healing to expect.

faqs.q: How do I request skin tag removal at Bloom Clinic Dubai?
faqs.a: Use the request form on this page or the Contact page. Our team will contact you about availability.

People ask about it to discuss skin hydration, dullness and texture. At **Bloom Clinic Dubai**, your specialist examines your skin, explains what the treatment involves and tells you whether it may suit you.

Looking for face mesotherapy in Dubai? Bloom Clinic offers a range of [face treatments](#services-face), including [PRP](#services-face), facials and skin peels. A consultation lets you compare options and decide at your own pace.

steps.title: Aftercare

faqs.q: What is mesotherapy for the face?
faqs.a: It is a treatment in which a prepared solution is placed in the skin with fine needles. Your specialist explains the solution and the areas treated at your consultation.

faqs.q: Is face mesotherapy painful?
faqs.a: Comfort varies from person to person and area to area. Your specialist explains what you may feel and how comfort is managed.

A very special thank you to Ms. Kanta for her professionalism, patience, attention to detail, and dedication throughout the entire treatment. She took her time with every step, and the final result was truly excellent and exactly what I was hoping for.

Based on my personal experience, I highly recommend Ms. Kanta to anyone considering SMP. You can trust her to work with great care and professionalism to achieve a natural and beautiful result.

I would also like to thank the entire Bloom Clinic team and management for their warm welcome, hospitality, and excellent service throughout my visits.

Thank you, Ms. Kanta and Bloom Clinic, for such a wonderful experience. Highly recommended
